Name: Crop Irrigation and Harvest Indicator
Author: Smlv04
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]

[size=4][font=Arial]A mod that adds native-style visual indicators to your farm. It instantly lets you know which crops, fruit trees, bushes, or indoor pots need watering, which are ready to harvest, and how many days are left until they are fully grown. It also features a built-in scanner to keep your crops safe from crows![/font][/size]


[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#ffffff]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Download this mod and extract it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Run the game using [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]![/color][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffffff][size=5][font=Arial Black][b]Main features[/b][/font][/size][/color]

[b][size=4]Visual Indicators:[/size][/b] A bubble with native-style indicators floats above your crops, fruit trees, tea bushes, and indoor pots to show water needs, harvest readiness, and growth days.

[b][size=4]Global Harvest Tracker:[/size][/b] A clean, solid HUD icon displays exactly how many crops are ready to be picked across your entire world. It features native alignment with UI Info Suite 2 Alternative to prevent screen clutter.

[size=4][b]Interactive Harvest Menu:[/b][/size] Press a customizable hotkey (Default: 'H') to open an organized menu showing a complete breakdown of mature crops, their quantities, and their global locations (like your custom Farm, Ginger Island, or expansion maps).

[size=4][b]Adaptive Bubbles:[/b][/size] The system intelligently detects the plant's state. If a crop needs water and still has days left to grow, the bubble dynamically expands to neatly display both pieces of information at the same time.

[b][size=4]Scarecrow Scanner:[/size][/b] Press a hotkey (Default: 'O') to toggle a red overlay on the ground, instantly highlighting any outdoor crops that are not protected by a scarecrow. 

[size=4][b]Multi-Harvest Safe:[/b][/size] Crops that regrow from the same plant will safely keep showing indicators, guaranteeing you never miss a continuous harvest!

[b][size=4]Junimo Hut Filter:[/size][/b] An intelligent configuration option that automatically hides harvest indicators for any crops sitting inside the collection range of a Junimo Hut, keeping your automated fields clean.

[size=4][b]Bee House Safety:[/b][/size] Automatically hides the harvest star on mature flowers within the range of a Bee House (5-tile radius), preventing accidental picking.

[b][size=4]Hide on Fully Grown:[/size][/b] Optionally hide the water indicator on single-harvest crops that are already mature and ready to be picked to keep your screen clean.

[b][size=4]Transparency Fade:[/size][/b] The icons seamlessly fade out as your character approaches, ensuring they never block your view while farming.

[size=4][b]Animated:[/b][/size] Smooth "bobbing" animation that feels like a native part of the game (can be disabled in settings).

[b][size=4]Deep Customization:[/size][/b][size=3] Full support for Generic Mod Config Menu! Easily tailor your experience by toggling specific indicators, and adjusting the overall bubble opacity to suit your farm's style.[/size]

[b][size=4]Global Translations:[/size][/b] Fully translated into 12 languages (Spanish, German, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Chinese).

[size=4][b]Toggle Mod:[/b][/size] Enable or disable the mod completely in-game.

[b][size=4]Cross-Platform:[/size][/b] Fully compatible with both PC and Android!


[size=5][font=Arial Black][b]Compatibility[/b][/font][/size]

[size=4]The scarecrow scanner is fully compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15290]Immersive Scarecrows[/url]" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44338]Immersive Sprinklers and Scarecrows[/url]" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn/mods]aedenthorn[/url].[/size]


[size=5][font=Arial Black][b]Changelog[/b][/font][/size]

[size=4][b]Version 1.6.0[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b][b][size=3]New Feature - Harvest Tracker & Menu:[/size][/b][/b] [size=3]Added a screen icon tracking total ready crops, and an interactive menu (Default: 'H') to view exactly what's mature and where (Farm, Ginger Island, SVE, RSV, etc.).[/size][/*]
[*][b][b]Scarecrow Scanner Overhaul:[/b][/b] [size=3]Activating the scanner now darkens the background so unprotected red tiles pop out instantly. The scarecrow tracker indicator above your character has been upgraded from the old default scarecrow texture to a solid, custom pumpkin sprite.[/size][/*]
[*][b]New Feature - Junimo Hut Filter:[/b] [size=3]Added a setting to automatically hide bubbles for crops that your Junimos are already handling.Compatibility: Added native support for UI Info Suite 2 Alternative; the tracker icon will automatically shift to line up perfectly with its interface.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Version 1.5.0[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Compatibility:[/b] It is now compatible with "Immersive Scarecrows" and "Immersive Sprinklers and Scarecrows" by aedenthorn.[/*]
[*][b]New Feature - Ignore Flowers:[/b] A new setting has been added to completely disable harvest indicators on all flowers. Ideal for players with decorative flower areas who don't want to harvest them.[/*]

[/list]
[b][size=4]Version 1.4.0[/size][/b]

[list]

[*][b]New Feature - Scarecrow Scanner:[/b] Added a toggleable hotkey (Default 'O') that displays a red overlay over outdoor crops missing scarecrow protection. Includes a handy UI icon over the player when active.[/*]
[*][size=3][b]New Feature - Bee House Protection:[/b] Added a config option (enabled by default) to hide harvest indicators on mature flowers near Bee Houses (5-tile radius).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Menu Overhaul:[/b] Completely reorganized the Generic Mod Config Menu to group settings logically.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Version 1.3.0[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Added Dynamic Bubbles: [/b]The mod now features adaptive bubbles that can combine multiple crop states at once. If a crop needs water and is ready to harvest (or has days left), both indicators will neatly display inside a single, unified bubble.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Version 1.2.0[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]New Feature:[/b] Added a Hide on Fully Grown option in the config menu (disabled by default). You can now choose to hide the water drop on single-harvest crops that are already mature.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Detection:[/b] Multi-harvest crops (like Blueberries or Corn) will safely ignore this setting and still show the indicator when fully grown, ensuring you never miss a watering day![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Version 1.1.0[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Added a new opacity slider in the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]You can now adjust how transparent or solid the water drops appear.[/*]
[/list]
